GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (17 Jul 46) LS
(SCAPIN - 1068)
APO 500
17 July 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 15 December 1945, file AG 000.5 (7 Dec 45) LS., wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one KAWASAKI, Matsuhei, Captain, to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said KAWASAKI'S name. This name appears as the 1st name on page No. 5 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
